comment: Written BEFORE any code reads a PATTERN (the W discipline). v0.32 is BLOCKS.md 4.3 and Central's item 3, the value join: a fact across declarations, said once as a pattern over a seat, judged by the pattern engine of v0.31. DEFINE PATTERN name AS (OVER kind.seat, MATCH [ rule ], SETS [kind.seat: set], MESSAGE, CODE, CITES, SEVERITY). The module docstring of gen_fixtures.py states the design each fixture pins. A1-A6 accept; R1-R27 refuse, each by the fragment of why. R7-R12 are the bound and the names, the pattern engine's own words in the meta-court's mouth; R25 is the pattern joining Art. 1.

accepts.name: a pattern over a seat, its set the values of another declaration's seat: the value join (OVER, SETS, MATCH, MESSAGE, CODE, CITES)
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE grants AS (VERSION "0.32", GRAMMAR "0.32", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".grant") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORM word AS (SEATS [value: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU channels AS (WORDS [mail, chat, call], CODE "UNKNOWN_CHANNEL") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION zone AS (VERB "ZONE", SEATS [rights: [word]]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION use AS (VERB "USE", SEATS [wants: [word], primary: name?, via: [word]?]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE PATTERN wants_granted AS (OVER use.wants, MATCH [INTO [ANY MEMBER granted]], MESSAGE "m", SETS [zone.rights: granted], CODE "RIGHT_NOT_GRANTED", CITES ["right:granted-by-a-zone"]) RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: a pattern uses another by RULE name: the patterns of a language are one set of named rules
accepts.source:

DEFINE DECLARATION use AS (VERB "USE", SEATS [wants: [word], primary: name?, via: [word]?]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE PATTERN granted_right AS (OVER use.primary, MATCH [MEMBER granted], MESSAGE "m", SETS [zone.rights: granted], CODE "PRIMARY_NOT_GRANTED") RATIONALE "x"

DEFINE DECLARATION zone AS (VERB "ZONE", SEATS [rights: [word]]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION use AS (VERB "USE", SEATS [wants: [word], primary: name?, via: [word]?]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORM limit AS (SEATS [right: name, max: number]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION cap AS (VERB "CAP", SEATS [limits: [limit]]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE PATTERN p AS (OVER use.wants, MATCH [INTO [ANY WORD]], MESSAGE "m", SETS [cap.limits: caps]) RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: SETS: 'cap.limits' is a list of pairs; a set draws from words, strings and numbers

rejects.name: Art. 1 explainability: a refusal is traceable by a stable identifier, so a PATTERN carries a CODE
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE grants AS (VERSION "0.32", GRAMMAR "0.32", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".grant") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORM word AS (SEATS [value: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU channels AS (WORDS [mail, chat, call], CODE "UNKNOWN_CHANNEL") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION zone AS (VERB "ZONE", SEATS [rights: [word]]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION use AS (VERB "USE", SEATS [wants: [word], primary: name?, via: [word]?]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE NARRATE voice AS (SAYS [use: "{name} wants {wants}."], REFUSES "Stopped at line {line}: {message} ({cites})") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE PATTERN p AS (OVER use.wants, MATCH [INTO [ANY WORD]], MESSAGE "m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTITUTION charter AS (ARTICLES [explainability]) RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: Art. 1 explainability: PATTERN 'p' carries no CODE
